title: shulker.lock
description: Shulker lock file. Tool-owned, key-sorted, pretty-printed. Records the exact resolution of shulker.json; install and build read only this file.

minecraft.description: Resolved Minecraft version id, exactly as Mojang's manifest names it.

loader.description: The resolved mod loader. Omitted when the project has no loader.

version.description: Resolved loader version, exactly as the loader's meta names it.

provides.description: Mod ids the loader jar provides, with their versions, e.g. the fabricloader version the Quilt loader stands in for. Validation treats them as installed.

client.description: NeoForge, Forge: the installer jar, locked the first time `link mojang` runs its client install. The client libraries the installer downloads itself stay unlocked, like the files Fabric's launcher fetches.

server.description: Server launcher, present once a server target has been installed.

installer.description: Fabric: installer version whose bundled server launcher is locked.

url.description: Download url of the jar in sha512. The quilt-server-launch.jar shulker generates has none.

sha512.description: The server launch jar: Fabric's bundled launcher, or the quilt-server-launch.jar shulker generates. NeoForge and Forge: their installer jar, which shulker runs offline into each server dir that doesn't have this loader version yet.

libraries.description: Quilt: the loader's libraries. NeoForge and Forge: every library their installer would download, so it runs offline. Keyed by Maven coordinate, placed under libraries/.

major.description: javaVersion.majorVersion from the Mojang version json, or the override's major.

component.description: Mojang runtime component name, e.g. java-runtime-epsilon. Used to fetch the managed runtime.

server.description: The vanilla server jar, present once a server target has been installed. Fabric's launcher finds it in .fabric/server/, Quilt's starts it as server.jar, and the NeoForge and Forge installers patch it from libraries/.

modpacks.description: Every modpack in the manifest's requires, keyed by its requires key.

mods.description: Every mod in the resolved set, direct and transitive, keyed by its requires key or, for a dependency, its in-jar mod id.

players.description: Every player referenced anywhere in the manifest, fully resolved. uuid is the identity across renames.

source.description: The manifest source at resolution time. A different source in the manifest makes the lock out of date.

ref.description: The manifest ref at resolution time. Git sources only.

dirSha256.description: Content hash of the modpack's shulker.json and override directories in sorted path order, excluding its lock, build output, and data. Local-path sources only.

sha256.description: Hash of the fetched manifest. Raw manifest URL sources only.

locked.description: Present when the modpack's mods were copied from its lock. Absent means they were resolved from its manifest.

lockSha256.description: Hash of the modpack's lock at resolution time. Present exactly when locked is.

project.description: Provider project id, typed as the provider types it.

version.description: Provider version id (Modrinth) or file id (CurseForge).

url.description: Download url. null when the author disabled third-party distribution; page is then required.

page.description: Provider file page for manual download. Present only when url is null.

sha512.description: Cache key and install verification hash.

size.description: Jar size in bytes as the provider reports it, for the download bar. Absent on entries locked before shulker recorded sizes; filled in when the mod is next resolved.

side.description: Effective side after any manifest override.

channel.description: Least stable channel accepted when this version was picked: the manifest's channel for a mod listed there or in a pack, the requiring mod's for a dependency. A listed mod whose manifest channel differs makes the lock out of date.

modpack.description: Key in modpacks of the locked modpack this entry was copied from. Absent for the project's own mods and the dependencies resolved for them.

modId.description: The jar's in-jar mod id. Present only when it differs from the entry's key; dependencies, validation and requiredBy use it.

requiredBy.description: Mod ids (or modpack keys) whose jar metadata depends on this mod. Empty plus absent from the manifest's requires and every modpack means orphan.

aliases.description: The same mod's project id on other providers, discovered on first download.

resolvedAt.description: When this name/uuid pair was last confirmed against Mojang.
